the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: reduce to the connected component over an algebraically closed field; in characteristic zero G is smooth and in characteristic p the reduction H is a smooth group scheme, so it suffices to treat a quasi-compact irreducible smooth group scheme over an algebraically closed field; choose an etale cover U of G over an affine space, a finite etale refinement W -> V, build the effective Cartier divisor T = (1 x pi')(D) on G x V whose components are Cartier since G x V has UFD local rings, and show the fibres E_v are unions of translates of D with affine complements avoiding any given k-point; the resulting invertible sheaves O_G(E_v) have constant class L by the rational-equivalence lemma, and the canonical sections give nonvanishing sections with affine nonvanishing loci, so L is ample by definition (source lines 1587-1697)
